nodes.label: ADR-013 Bounded synchronous document generation
nodes.summary: Accepted MVP decision: synchronous per-chapter generation with quotas, loading, generated-only downloads, failed state and idempotent retry.
nodes.rationale: Queue migration changes submission and needs workers/monitoring/polling beyond MVP; quotas bound direct requests.
nodes.status: Accepted for MVP; production operational thresholds still require review
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Synchronous generation status and idempotent retry
nodes.summary: Per chapter sync generation, loading state, only generated downloads; failure saves safe code and reuses snapshot record on retry.
nodes.rationale: MVP can complete in one request without exposing partial artifacts.

nodes.label: Production queue migration threshold
nodes.summary: Monitor request duration/memory/renderer timeout/failure count; planned queue change required before actual scale or duration exceeds approved threshold.
nodes.rationale: Bounded MVP execution is not evidence of safe unbounded production load.
